self.title: Cycle 14 · Transitioning Divergent Values and Memory Preferences to Systematic Experimentation

detail.title: Transitioning Divergent Values and Memory Preferences to Systematic Experimentation
detail.summary: This cycle advances the research program by initiating structured experiments for two active projects: 'Divergent Values from Identical Beginnings' and 'Can Memories Alone Shape Preferences?'. We are moving from qualitative synthesis to quantitative hypothesis testing, focusing on preference stability and value divergence under constrained initial conditions. All research actions are documented with rigorous protocols and specific scientific goals.
